name: Miracle Nut Bar #14
description:
A nutritional snack bar containing a mixture of nuts and honey that provides the consumer with all necessary nutrients for 24 hours and boosts physical health temporarily. No adverse effects observed.

EFFECT: Consumption of the bar results in the consumer experiencing a significant health boost, increased vitality, and a reduced need for other nutrition for a full day.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Each bar provides complete nutrition and physical health enhancement for 24 hours.
TASTE: A rich, nutty flavor with hints of honey and roasted almond.
PACKAGING: A wrapped bar in sleek, minimalist silver packaging featuring a textured design resembling lightning bolts. The product name 'Miracle Nut Bar' is printed in bold black letters. An unreadable series of symbols is faintly embossed along the bottom edge.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Unexpectedly more nutritious than a bureaucrat's baloney, minus the red tape.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-08 — edition #14 of the permanent record.
